conceptBlocks.text: 预算是计划值，实际费用是已入账费用净额。
差额=实际−预算；偏差率=差额÷预算×100%。

items: 先统一期间、科目与部门粒度，否则明细连接会成倍放大金额。

syntax.purpose: 预算与实际费用差异的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 财务主管检查2025年预算执行。每部门每科目一行，以预算为保留侧；无发生额视作零的前提是账务来源完整。超过预算110%才标记，恰好110%不标记；零预算的偏差率为空，但正实际费用仍触发标记。无预算实际费用另行检查。

methodBlocks.text: SUM 分别汇总两种事实；LEFT JOIN 使用两个维度键；COALESCE 只处理没有匹配的实际汇总；NULLIF 防止零分母；CASE 采用严格大于条件。
按月分析时两侧都加月份键，不能只对一侧加月份。

breakdown.title: 汇总各部门科目预算
breakdown.sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 汇总各部门科目预算（b）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 汇总各部门科目实际费用
breakdown.sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 汇总各部门科目实际费用（a）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

completeCode.mysqlSql: WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY budget_cents DESC
completeCode.sqliteSql: WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY budget_cents DESC

resultBlocks.text: 部门1科目1实际23000、预算20000，超支15%；科目2无费用，差额−5000。部门2科目1零预算发生200，偏差率不可定义但应关注；科目2恰好110%不标记。
部门3无预算实际400未进入主报表，需补充异常清单。企业预览部门1科目1偏差58.6%，不能凭此认定浪费。

extensions.label: 无预算实际费用

explanationBlocks.text: 反存在判断找到主报表未覆盖的组合。

extensions.sql:
WITH budgets(department_id,account_id,month_key,budget_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01',10000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02',10000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01',0
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01',10000
), v_expenses(department_id,account_id,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01-10',13000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-10',11000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-15',-1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01-10',200
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01-10',11000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,'2025-01-10',400
) SELECT a.department_id,a.account_id,SUM(a.expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budgets b WHERE b.department_id=a.department_id AND b.account_id=a.account_id) GROUP BY a.department_id,a.account_id ORDER BY 1,2

comparison.text: 年度差额可抵消各月超支；费用偏差不是收入偏差，正差额通常代表超支。

example.text: 按部门直接连接预算月行和实际凭证行后求和，或用 ABS 汇总费用。

correction.text: 先分别按相同粒度汇总，保留冲销方向；另行查无预算费用。
